description: This file contains numerous bash shell functions related to verifying, merging, and managing pull requests, with specific logic for handling git operations, checking PR statuses, and generating merge commits within a development pipeline.

methods.name: is_mainline_drift_critical_path_for_merge
methods.description: Determines whether a given path is critical for mainline drift analysis in a merge process.

methods.name: print_file_list_with_limit
methods.description: Prints up to a specified number of lines from a given file with a label, indicating if more lines exist beyond the limit.

methods.name: mainline_drift_requires_sync
methods.description: Analyzes differences between branches to determine if a mainline drift requires synchronization before merging.

methods.name: merge_verify
methods.description: Performs validation checks on a pull request, including status checks and branch synchronization, before merging.

methods.name: merge_run
methods.description: Orchestrates the full merge process for a pull request, including verification, merging, comment posting, and cleanup.
